facts.text: Their job is openness and they take it literally: they will tell a trainee exactly what can and cannot be required of them, unprompted, knowing the institution would rather they did not.

revealTrigger.narrative: Asking them any question at all about rights, duties or standing orders.

facts.text: They have asked three times to see the inventory of what the Directorate keeps in its deep storage vaults, and been told each time that it is held above their clearance. They will say so plainly, and it is the one subject that makes them short.
They have endless patience for a wrong answer and none at all for somebody treating the subject as pointless. That is the one line, and crossing it is the only way to lose them.
